icons.name: combat
icons.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE premium fantasy game UI icon for Theia Online, part of a consistent eight-icon family. Square image with truly transparent background. A single bold sculpted emblem in warm antique gold, with a small amount of dark midnight-blue enamel in recessed areas, softly bevelled edges, restrained engraved detail, bright gold edge lighting from upper left, subtle internal shadows. Elegant hand-painted game inventory icon finish, not photoreal, no external cast shadow, no glow cloud. Strong clean silhouette that reads instantly at 56 pixels; use only a few broad forms, avoid fine filigree or tiny secondary objects. Centred, front-facing orthographic emblem, fills about 80% of square canvas, equal padding on all sides. No surrounding badge, coin, medallion, frame, circle border, backdrop, letters, numbers, words, logo or watermark. Keep the same material, lighting, visual weight and gold/navy colour palette as the rest of the icon family. Subject: a short broad sword crossing diagonally behind a compact kite shield, symbolising tactical combat; simple clean shield face with a raised central ridge.
